name: shelf-mode-wake
description: The field report behind TandemKit's undatable-history rule, compressed into eight hours on a 0.85 U/hr profile: a 2.0 U and a 1.0 U pump bolus, delivery suspended 445 minutes ago, then shelf mode 441 minutes ago (a ShelfMode record) and the pump woken at once with its clock restarted at 2008-01-01 (NewDay, ArmInit, VersionInfo), set on its screen to 2020-01-01 four minutes later (a DateChange), and still suspended. Setup's clock write then moves the pump about 6.9 years forward; a driver that adds that change to the boluses from before shelf mode reports them years in the future.
